description: Positional comparison of gnomAD pLoF versus disease-causing DOCK11 truncating alleles, and prevalence upper bound
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

q = """
{ gene(gene_symbol: "DOCK11", reference_genome: GRCh38) {
    variants(dataset: gnomad_r4) { variant_id consequence hgvsp
      exome { ac an ac_hemi filters } genome { ac an ac_hemi filters } lof } } }
"""
v=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},timeout=180).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
rows=[]
for x in v:
    e=x.get("exome") or {}; g=x.get("genome") or {}
    rows.append({"csq":x["consequence"],"hgvsp":x.get("hgvsp"),"lof":x.get("lof"),
                 "ac":(e.get("ac") or 0)+(g.get("ac") or 0),
                 "an":max(e.get("an") or 0,g.get("an") or 0),
                 "hemi":(e.get("ac_hemi") or 0)+(g.get("ac_hemi") or 0),
                 "nf":len((e.get("filters") or [])+(g.get("filters") or []))})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df=df[(df.lof=="HC")&(df.nf==0)].copy()
L=2073
df["pos"]=df.hgvsp.apply(lambda h: int(re.search(r'p\.[A-Za-z]{3}(\d+)',h).group(1)) if isinstance(h,str) and re.search(r'p\.[A-Za-z]{3}(\d+)',h) else np.nan)
coding=df.dropna(subset=["pos"])
hemi_pos=coding.loc[coding.hemi>0,"pos"]; nohemi_pos=coding.loc[coding.hemi==0,"pos"]
disease=[1252,1299,1464,1793,2012]

print(f"HC PASS pLoF: {len(df)} | with protein position: {len(coding)}")
print(f"seen hemizygous: n={len(hemi_pos)} median codon {hemi_pos.median():.0f} ({100*hemi_pos.median()/L:.0f}% ORF)")
print(f"not hemizygous : n={len(nohemi_pos)} median codon {nohemi_pos.median():.0f}")
print(f"disease alleles: median codon {np.median(disease):.0f} ({100*np.median(disease)/L:.0f}% ORF)")
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(hemi_pos,disease,alternative="less")
rb=2*u/(len(hemi_pos)*len(disease))-1
print(f"Mann-Whitney (gnomAD-hemi < disease): U={u:.0f}, p={p:.4f}, rank-biserial={rb:.3f}")
print(f"gnomAD hemizygous pLoF at/after DOCKER start 1609: {(hemi_pos>=1609).sum()}/{len(hemi_pos)} ({100*(hemi_pos>=1609).mean():.0f}%)")
print(f"Total hemizygous HC pLoF observations: {df.hemi.sum()}")
print(f"Crude upper-bound male pLoF carrier freq (~400,000 gnomAD v4 males): {df.hemi.sum()/400000:.2e} = 1 in {400000/df.hemi.sum():,.0f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,4.6))
for s,e,c,lab in [(165,272,"#8e44ad","PH"),(640,818,"#d68910","C2 / DHR-1"),(1609,2036,"#c0392b","DOCKER / DHR-2 (GEF)")]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,-0.5),e-s,1.0,color=c,alpha=0.22)); ax.text((s+e)/2,0.88,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8,color=c)
ax.scatter(nohemi_pos,np.full(len(nohemi_pos),0.30),s=16,color="#aab7b8",label=f"gnomAD pLoF, no hemizygote (n={len(nohemi_pos)})")
ax.scatter(hemi_pos,np.full(len(hemi_pos),0.05),s=36,color="#2874a6",label=f"gnomAD pLoF seen in hemizygous males (n={len(hemi_pos)})")
ax.scatter(disease,np.full(len(disease),-0.28),s=130,marker="v",color="#922b21",label="Reported disease truncating alleles (n=5)")
for d,lab in zip(disease,["Q1252*","L1299fs","I1464fs","S1793fs","Y2012*"]):
    ax.text(d,-0.38,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#922b21")
ax.set_xlim(0,L); ax.set_ylim(-0.55,1.0); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("DOCK11 codon (of 2073)")
ax.set_title("Truncating DOCK11 alleles: gnomAD v4 population variants versus reported disease alleles\n"
             f"disease alleles sit later in the ORF (median codon {np.median(disease):.0f} vs {hemi_pos.median():.0f}), Mann-Whitney p={p:.3f}",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper left",frameon=False); ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
